REPLACEMENT of the expansion backlog, not conversion of it - 2026Q2 proved the conversion leg (backlog fell $10.1B -> $9.6B because >$650M went INTO SERVICE), so the thesis now hinges on whether the >$10B unsanctioned "shadow" opportunity set keeps converting into sanctioned backlog at the sub-6x multiple faster than in-service placements drain it; KMI's own 10y record contains one backlog that was high-graded DOWN ($12-13B in 2016 to ~$2-6B across 2019-2023).
